title: China’s Revised Defense Mobilization Law Touches Nearly Every Sector
gist: China's revised National Defense Mobilization Law took effect October 1, 2026, the first major overhaul since 2010. While the original law was Taiwan-centric war preparation, the revision reaches many stakeholders and sectors of the economy, widening the state's ability to convert civilian capacity into military capability.
